name: pi-dev-team
title_zh: 先出方案再动手，带 UI 草稿和提交信息的多智能体开
tagline_zh: 改需求最怕一上来就写代码。它先让规划智能体把改动拆清楚，需要界面就先出网页草稿给你看。
tagline_en: It plans the change first, mocks up web UI when needed, then hands off to specialist agents and official stack.
desc_en: Pi package for /devteam: plan a change, optionally mock up web UI, then implement it with specialized agents and official stack skills. Isolated children keep your other Pi extensions. Drafts a commit message; does not auto-commit.
why_zh: 规划和实现分成两拨智能体，各自只干一件事，比一个全能助手少犯糊涂；草稿先给你看，省掉返工。
why_en: Planning and implementation are split across separate agents, each doing one job, so it stays sharper than a do-everything.
limit_zh: 只跑在 Pi 环境里，得先装好 Pi 和官方栈技能；UI 草稿仅限网页界面，桌面端和移动原生它不画；到提交信息为止。
limit_en: Runs only inside Pi with the official stack skills installed. UI mockups cover web only, not desktop or native mobile. It stops at the commit.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Plan, mock up, then build: a multi-agent dev pipeline
